name: an inline box broken across lines draws one box per line, its side borders at its ends
description: LAYOUT23 proof 3. A span with a border, a background and side padding around words that cross a line break, with a <b> inside it: each line gets one yellow box; the left border only on the first line, the right one only on the last; the padding moves the text once, not per word or per nested <b> (see the screenshot). The paragraph is three lines at its 220 px.

html: Some words before a boxed run of text that crosses the line break and after.
css: .box { border: 2px solid blue; background: yellow; padding: 0 6px; }

name: a background image is drawn at its declared size, centred, repeated along x and clipped to its box
description: LAYOUT23 proof 2. A 300 x 100 box with `background: url(tile) center / 50px 50px repeat-x` over a grey fill shows one blue band 50 px tall across the box's middle and nothing below or above it; a second box with `background-size: cover` is blue all over. Run once with AZ_BACKEND=cpu and once with AZ_BACKEND=gpu: the screenshots are the same.

css: .band { width: 300px; height: 100px; margin: 10px; background: #dddddd url("tile") center / 50px 50px repeat-x; }
.cover { width: 300px; height: 100px; margin: 10px; background-color: #dddddd; background-image: url("tile"); background-size: cover; }

name: an inline list item shows its marker before its text on the same line
description: LAYOUT23 proof 7. `display: inline list-item` items in a line: each shows its marker (a number in an ordered list, a bullet otherwise) before its text, and the whole stays one line.

css: ol, ul { margin: 10px; padding: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 20px; }
.inline { display: inline list-item; list-style-position: inside; margin-right: 12px; }
